title: OpenAI doubles Work and Codex allowances on Pro, and cancels a planned cut
friendlyTitle: OpenAI doubled some ChatGPT Pro work limits, and canceled a planned cut
summary: OpenAI's help page for ChatGPT Pro, updated on 30 October, says Pro 100 and Pro 500 now include twice their previous Work and Codex allowance. On Pro 200, a reduction announced in a 29 September email is canceled. Subscribers who already had the higher allowance keep it. Those on the lower allowance have had it doubled to match, and the price stays $200 a month. Plus is unchanged.
friendlySummary: OpenAI updated its Pro help page on 30 October. The $100 and $500 Pro plans now include twice as much Work and Codex use as before. Work and Codex are the parts of ChatGPT used for longer jobs and coding. On the $200 plan, a cut announced in a 29 September email is canceled. People who already had the higher limit keep it. People on the lower limit have had it doubled. The Plus plan is unchanged.
whyItMatters: You do not need to cancel and resubscribe. Existing subscribers receive the updated allowance automatically, and a larger allowance does not guarantee twice as many finished tasks. Ultrafast, the faster mode for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, remains available only on the $500 Pro plan. Buying credits on Pro 100 or Pro 200 does not unlock it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You do not need to cancel and sign up again. Current subscribers get the new allowance on their own. A bigger allowance does not guarantee twice as many finished tasks, because harder models and longer jobs use more of it. The fastest mode, Ultrafast, is still only on the $500 plan. Buying extra credits on the $100 or $200 plan does not turn that mode on.
